verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI personal assistant that acts on live email, calendar, Slack and to-dos, so a sandbox, dry-run or test mode is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test environment or way to try actions without touching real accounts. The integrations described all operate directly on the user's own data, and no developer or API test surface was found (the OpenAPI probes returned 404).
